description: Source code for the 'recap' API endpoints in Mattermost, handling creation, retrieval, updating, regeneration, and deletion of recaps, with audit logging and feature flag checks.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API class with method to initialize recap routes

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Context object used for request handling, including user session, app, and request parameters

methods.name: InitRecap
methods.description: Initializes the recap-related API routes and handlers

methods.name: requireRecapsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if AI recaps feature is enabled; sets error if disabled

methods.name: addRecapChannelIDsToAuditRec
methods.description: Extracts channel IDs from a recap and adds them to the audit record

methods.name: createRecap
methods.description: Handles creation of a new recap, including validation, audit logging, and response

methods.name: getRecap
methods.description: Retrieves a specific recap, checks permissions, logs accessed channels, and returns the recap

methods.name: getRecaps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recaps for the user, with audit logging

methods.name: markRecapAsRead
methods.description: Marks a specific recap as read, with permission check and audit logging

methods.name: regenerateRecap
methods.description: Regenerates a recap, with permission check, channel logging, and audit

methods.name: deleteRecap
methods.description: Deletes a recap after permission check, with audit logging
